Search the empty flat for {parent.first}'s child

parent_meet.speaker: parent
parent_meet.text: {parent.first} {parent.family} hasn't slept. "My kid's been gone since yesterday. Someone saw them near an empty flat a few blocks over."

found.text: Inside {child_place.name}, curled up asleep behind a stack of crates: the child, cold but fine. {parent.first} cries all the way home.
